title: A blocked anagram
description: data/promotions/blocks.jsonl: an anagram that may not be promoted, by its code only, so its words are never published here. The API refuses its promotions and leaves them out of the counts, and the pages hide its Promote and Submit.

key_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the promotion key, as lowercase hex: the code an anagram is published under in place of its words.
